notes: Architecture is a decision-framework / knowledge skill for system-level structural choices and ADRs. It overlaps with design-function (the per-feature TECH spec executor); the boundary eval keeps them distinct.

evals.prompt: We're adding a background job system to our monolith. Should this be a new module, a separate service, or middleware? Walk me through the trade-offs before we commit.
evals.expected_output: Applies the decision tree, biases toward the simplest option that satisfies current needs, weighs the new-dependency cost explicitly, respects existing module boundaries, and records an ADR at docs/specs/decisions/ADR-architecture-[YYYYMMDD].md capturing decision, alternatives, and consequences.

evals.prompt: Write an ADR documenting our decision to stay a single deployable monolith instead of splitting into microservices right now.
evals.expected_output: Produces an ADR in the skill's ADR format (Context / Decision / Alternatives Considered table / Consequences), written to docs/specs/decisions/ADR-architecture-[YYYYMMDD].md, with a re-check trigger for when to revisit.

evals.prompt: Design the API endpoints and ORM schema for the new orders feature.
evals.expected_output: Should route to design-function (produces docs/specs/detail-design/TECH-orders.md), not architecture — this is a per-feature endpoint/schema tech spec, whereas architecture is for system-level structural decisions and ADRs.
